q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Wang Fang. I’m twelve years old. I live in Chengdu, in China. My cousin can speak English very well, because she studies at a university in Beijing. I usually have English lessons on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings. In my last English lesson, we read a story about a dog and then we talked about it in groups. It was fun, and the teacher gave us some homework. At school I play basketball and I sometimes run. When I do sport, I wear a T-shirt, shorts and trainers.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如家里谁会说英语、上次英语课做了什么、在学校做什么运动），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like snowboarding because it’s exciting, but I’ve never tried it. I don’t like visiting castles very much. Barbecues on the beach are great because you can swim and eat with your family. I think visiting a castle is interesting if you like history. Sightseeing in a city isn’t boring, because there are lots of things to see. Having a barbecue on the beach is exciting, especially in the evening. Snowboarding in the mountains is fun, but it can be dangerous. Taking photos is important because you can remember your holiday. I like having a barbecue on the beach best. Yes, I like going on holiday to a city, because there are good shops and museums. I prefer one long holiday, because I can relax and do more things.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图中每种度假活动表明喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问（参观城堡、城市观光、海滩烧烤、滑雪板、拍照等），说出最喜欢哪一种，并用 because、but 等连接词展开。
